WITH RECURSIVE packaging_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        packaging_id,
        contains_id,
        qty as current_qty,
        0 as level,
        packaging_id as root_id
    FROM packaging_relations
    WHERE packaging_id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        ph.current_qty * pr.qty as current_qty,
        ph.level + 1,
        ph.root_id
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    JOIN packaging_hierarchy ph ON pr.packaging_id = ph.contains_id
),
true_leaves AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(current_qty) as total_leaf_quantity
    FROM packaging_hierarchy
    WHERE contains_id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
    )
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(total_leaf_quantity) as avg_total_quantity,
    COUNT(*) as num_combinations
FROM true_leaves
